title: DoDonPachi
note: Shoot'em up by Cave (CAVE): lives, lives_p2, bombs, bombs_p2, bombs_max, bombs_max_p2, power, power_p2, combo, combo_p2, ship, ship_p2 (FinalBurn Neo cheat database). Made by tools/cave_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Cave 68000 work RAM from 0x100000 (64 KB), bytes swapped within 16-bit words

lives.note: lives (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Lives PL1)

lives_p2.note: lives of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Lives PL2)

bombs.note: bombs of player 1, 6 at most (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Bombs PL1, the first byte)

bombs_p2.note: bombs of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Bombs PL2)

bombs_max.note: bomb slots of player 1: 3 at the start, one more for each ship lost, 6 at most (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Bombs PL1, the second byte, capacity in MAME's notes)

bombs_max_p2.note: bomb slots of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Bombs PL2, the second byte)

power.note: shot level of player 1, 4 at most (FBNeo cheat database, Maximum Shot PL1, the second byte, its state in MAME's notes)

power_p2.note: shot level of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Maximum Shot PL2)

combo.note: combo gauge of player 1, full = 0x37: it drains, each enemy destroyed fills it (FBNeo cheat database, Maximum Combo PL1)

combo_p2.note: combo gauge of player 2, full = 0x37 (FBNeo cheat database, Maximum Combo PL2)

ship.note: ship of player 1: 0 type A (red fighter), 1 type B (helicopter), 2 type C (blue fighter) (FBNeo cheat database, Select Option Type PL1)

ship_p2.note: ship of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Select Option Type PL2)

credits.note: credits, not in the cheat databases: learn it with learn.bat (credits=...)

hits.note: hit counter of player 1 (the combo shown as HIT), learn it with learn.bat (hits=...)

hits_p2.note: hit counter of player 2, learn it with learn.bat in a two-player game (hits2=...)

score.note: player 1 score, not in the cheat databases: learn it with learn.bat (score=...)

score_p2.note: player 2 score, learn it with learn.bat in a two-player game (score2=...)

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move, as long as one of the moving ones is read (lives or bombs alone change too seldom)

coins.note: credits not read: counted from the coin buttons (coin_buttons.bat). A player begins (start, continue, joining in) and uses one when his lives come back from 0 by 2 or more (an extra life is 1)
